text: Amy Williams | composer, pianist Skip to content Amy Williams composer | pianist About Media Expand Discography Articles/Interviews Photos Works Piano Contact Amy Williams composer | pianist Toggle Menu “Amy Williams’ harmonic choices are always both refined and surprising, and her mastery of rhetoric compelling at every turn.” — San Francisco Classical Voice Composer and pianist Amy Williams writes evocative music that draws imaginative connections between music and painting, poetry, film, photography, philosophy. Her work is often in dialogue with music of past luminaries including Art Tatum, John Cage, Charles Ives, György Ligeti, Igor Stravinsky, Nicola Vicentino and J.S. Bach. Her compositional approach is deeply influenced by decades of performing contemporary music as a chamber musician and soloist. She creates music with rhythmic complexity that has an enigmatic groove, expanded instrumental sound worlds, and engaging performer interactions. This entry is for information purposes only. Materials for this work may be lodged in our collection in the future. Until then, any enquiries should be made directly to the composer/sound artist or their agent. Work Overview This work is unusual as it exists in two forms "fire" and "flood", with largely the same material, but extreme difference in the orchestration. The terms "fire" and "flood" come from their different destructive effects, and the consequent effects of the different instrumentation. This version reveals the heavy, dark and overwhelming effects of flood. The title of The Undone Years is a line from ' Strange Meeting' by the WWI war poet Wilfred Owen. Owen's poetry combines masterful poetic craft with the most unrestrained imagery and brings home his first-hand experience of the horrors of the Great War. The resulting work is of dark contrasts, exploring the idea of "what might have been", whether death and destruction or renewed life. Work Details Year : 2010 Duration : 25 min. Difficulty : Advanced — The solo part is virtuosic and expects altissimo range and mutiphonics. The band parts are moderate. Contents note : I. The undone years -- II. The old lie -- III. Spring wind -- IV. Legs as quick as lilac-shoots. Commission note : Commissioned by Jason Xanthoudakis .. Commissioned by Jason Xanthoudakis.
